name: embed-dialog
title: Embed dialog
description: Let people embed your content: size and theme controls, a live code snippet that updates as they choose, and a copy button that confirms.
docs: buildSnippet(settings) returns the code for { width, height, theme, responsive }, and runs again on every change. embed-dialog/snippet exports escapeAttribute, which makes a value safe inside a double-quoted attribute (a quote or an ampersand cannot break out of it), and iframeSnippet, which writes an escaped iframe with lazy loading, the theme in the address, and for responsive a full-width wrapper that keeps the aspect ratio. controls picks which of width, height, theme and responsive to show. previewUrl (or a function of the settings) frames a page in a sandboxed frame of the same size (scripts run, but in an origin of their own; pass trustedPreview for a page of your own origin that needs its storage, and accept that such a page can lift its own sandbox), and preview draws it yourself; the frame is shrunk to fit and says by how much. With a preview the dialog is wider and the options sit beside it, so the code and its copy button stay in view. The code keeps its own lines and scrolls sideways when one is too long. The copy button confirms and is announced, and onCopy reports it. EmbedPanel is the inside on its own.
